pages.x: After Sun Yat-sen died, his Nationalist party, led by the general Chiang Kai-shek, set out with its Communist allies to beat the warlords and unite China. In April 1927, as his army took Shanghai, Chiang turned on the Communists and had thousands of them and their trade union allies killed. Civil war followed.

The Communists fled to the countryside. In the hills of Jiangxi, Mao Zedong, a farmer's son and former library assistant, built a little Soviet republic on the support of poor peasants, giving them land taken from landlords, and fought Chiang's armies with guerrilla tactics.

In 1934 Chiang's armies surrounded them, and about 86,000 Communists broke out and marched west and north, over mountains and rivers and through swamps, for a whole year. Fewer than 10,000 reached the caves of Yan'an in the far north. On the way Mao became the party's leader, and the march became its founding legend.

In December 1936 one of Chiang's own generals kidnapped him at Xi'an and made him agree to fight Japan alongside the Communists. When Japan invaded in 1937 the two sides fought it together, in name at least, while watching each other. Behind the Japanese lines the Communist armies grew to around a million fighters.

After Japan's defeat the civil war began again in 1946. Chiang had more men and American weapons, but his government was riddled with corruption and runaway prices, and many of his soldiers deserted. In 1948 and 1949 the Communists won three huge campaigns in the north and centre, and crossed the Yangtze.

On 1 October 1949 Mao stood on the Gate of Heavenly Peace in Beijing and proclaimed the People's Republic of China. Chiang fled with some two million soldiers and refugees to the island of Taiwan, where his Republic of China lives on. No peace treaty was ever signed.

pages.x: The Communist victory made China the world's largest communist country and shaped Asia for the rest of the century. Taiwan and the mainland still have separate governments, and their future is one of the most dangerous questions in world politics.
pts: The People's Republic was founded on 1 October 1949
